name: busy
title: Busy
description: A region whose content is being fetched again, under a veil and a spinner.
use: A card, a table or a panel that already shows content and is refreshing it: after a filter changes, while a form saves. The old content keeps its place under a veil, so nothing jumps when the new content arrives. Set aria-busy="true" while the work runs and remove it after; add inert to keep the keyboard out, and say what is happening in a live region.

instead.when: The content has never loaded and only its shape is known
The wait belongs to one button or one line
The amount of work is known

classes.name: busy
classes.description: On the region itself: while it carries aria-busy="true", a veil in the color of its surface steps the content back and a spinner turns in the middle. The veil takes the region's corner and waits 160ms before it shows

states.name: busy
states.description: The region is being refreshed. Without the attribute the class draws nothing
